name: Bind ERP
description: Connect Bind ERP, the Mexican cloud ERP, to Claude or ChatGPT: clients and prospects, providers, products and inventory per warehouse, orders, quotes, sales with their CFDI XML, purchase orders, expenses, chart of accounts and journal entries, with OData filters. Writes and CFDI creation ship switched off.
instructions:
## Bind ERP
This connector uses the **Bind ERP API** (`https://api.bind.com.mx`), the REST API of Bind ERP, the Mexican cloud ERP for small and medium companies: clients and prospects, providers, products, services, inventory per warehouse, client orders, quotes, sales with their CFDI, purchase orders, expenses, the chart of accounts and journal entries, CRM activities and comments.

**Setup (about 5 minutes)**
1. In Bind ERP click your user name (top right) > **Perfil**, open the **Integraciones** tab of the user profile, enter your password and click **Generar API Key**. Bind issues a long key (a JWT, valid for one year); copy it.
2. Paste it into `BINDERP_API_TOKEN`. The connector sends it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The key acts as the Bind user who generated it, with that user's permissions, so generate it as a user who may see what the assistant needs.
3. Generate a new key before the year is over and paste it here; an expired key answers 401.

**Limits**: with the API key alone Bind allows 150 calls every 5 minutes and 5,000 a day. Registering on Bind's developer portal and asking Bind for a subscription doubles that, at no extra cost. Prefer filtered lists over paging through everything.

**Lists and filters**: list tools take OData options: `filter` (for example `RFC eq 'XAXX010101000'`, `Date ge datetime'2026-10-01T00:00:00'`, `substringof('ACME', LegalName)`, GUIDs as `guid'...'`), `orderby` (`Date desc`), `top` and `skip`. A page holds 50 rows by default; the answer carries `value`, `count` and `nextLink`. Detail tools take the record's ID (a GUID) from the lists.

**IDs you will need**: many tools and every document need GUIDs of a branch (`binderp_list_locations`), a warehouse (`binderp_list_warehouses`), a price list (`binderp_list_price_lists`) and a currency (`binderp_list_currencies`). Look them up once per conversation. Inventory per warehouse and products with price and stock need a warehouse and a price list.

**Invoices (CFDI)**: `binderp_list_invoices` and `binderp_get_invoice` read sales; `binderp_get_invoice_xml` returns the stamped CFDI XML (the SAT document) as text. Creating a sale with `IsFiscalInvoice` true stamps a CFDI with the SAT, which can only be undone by a formal cancellation, so `binderp_create_invoice` is installed switched off.

**Writing**: creating and changing clients, prospects, products, orders, quotes and comments are installed **switched off**. Turn on only the tools you need, and confirm every change with the user. The connector does not register payments, bank movements, inventory adjustments or credit notes.

**Errors**: 401 means the token is wrong, expired or revoked; 403 the token's user lacks the permission; 404 on a detail tool usually means a wrong or deleted ID.
prerequisites: A Bind ERP account and an API key generated under your user Perfil > Integraciones > Generar API Key; the key is valid for one year and acts with that user's permissions.

BINDERP_API_TOKEN.label: Bind ERP API key
BINDERP_API_TOKEN.help: Bind ERP: your user name (top right) > Perfil > Integraciones > Generar API Key. It is a long JWT (three parts separated by dots), valid for one year.
BINDERP_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the token alone, without Bearer, quotes or spaces.

verifyHints.401: Bind ERP refused the token: it is wrong, revoked or older than one year. Generate a new one under your user Perfil > Integraciones > Generar API Key and paste it into BINDERP_API_TOKEN.
verifyHints.403: The key works, but its Bind user lacks the permission for this. Give the user the role, or generate the key as a user who has it.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Bind allows 150 calls every 5 minutes and 5,000 a day per API key. Wait a few minutes and try again.

tools.name: binderp_get_company_profile
tools.description: Read the company profile of the Bind ERP account: legal and commercial name, RFC, tax regime, address and when the CFDI signing certificate (CSD) expires.

tools.name: binderp_get_user_profile
tools.description: Read the profile of the Bind user the API token belongs to: name, email and role. Quick check that the token works.

tools.name: binderp_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Bind account (salespeople, credit contacts), whose IDs appear on clients, orders and invoices. OData paging and filters; the answer holds value, count and nextLink.

filter.description: OData filter, e.g. Name eq 'Ana'. Strings in single quotes, GUIDs as guid'...', dates as datetime'2026-10-01T00:00:00'.

skip.description: Rows to skip, for paging with top.

tools.name: binderp_create_client
tools.description: Create a client with its fiscal data and address. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

LegalName.description: Legal name (razón social), as registered with the SAT.

tools.name: binderp_update_client
tools.description: Change a client's fiscal data, credit terms, price list or contacts. Send the fields to keep as well: Bind replaces the record. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

LegalName.description: Legal name (razón social), as registered with the SAT.

tools.name: binderp_create_prospect
tools.description: Create a prospect (lead) with contact, company, email and phone. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

IsPublic.description: true to share with all users.

tools.name: binderp_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a client, prospect, order or other record. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

ExternalID.description: ID (GUID) of the client, prospect, order or other record the comment belongs to.

tools.name: binderp_create_product
tools.description: Create a product with code, title, cost, price and categories. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

tools.name: binderp_create_order
tools.description: Create a client order (pedido) with product and service lines. No CFDI is stamped. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

Emails.description: Emails to send the document to.

Products.description: Product lines: [{"ID": "<product GUID>", "Qty": 2, "Price": 150.0, "VAT": 16, "Comments": ""}]. VAT is the rate in percent.

tools.name: binderp_create_quote
tools.description: Create a quote (cotización) for a client or prospect. Installed switched off: confirm with the user first.

ClientProspect.description: Who the quote is for: {"isNew": false, "Client": {"ClientId": "<GUID>"}} or {"isNew": false, "Prospect": {"ID": "<GUID>"}}.

Emails.description: Emails to send the quote to.

tools.name: binderp_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a sale and, with IsFiscalInvoice true, stamp it as a CFDI with the SAT. A stamped CFDI is a legal tax document: it can only be undone by a formal cancellation. Payments are not registered by this tool. Installed switched off: confirm client, lines, taxes and CFDI use with the user first.

Emails.description: Emails to send the document to.

Products.description: Product lines: [{"ID": "<product GUID>", "Qty": 2, "Price": 150.0, "VAT": 16, "Comments": ""}]. VAT is the rate in percent.

CFDIUse.description: CFDI use code (uso del CFDI) as Bind numbers it.

IsFiscalInvoice.description: true to stamp a CFDI with the SAT; false for a non-fiscal sale.

Serie.description: Series to number the invoice with.
